title: LA Colossal – Black Najeon 01 (Standing)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her early 50s, silver-white hair in a sleek low bun with a mother-of-pearl binyeo, natural face with a serene smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer with subtle brush texture, not a bodysuit, inlaid with thick cut mother-of-pearl in pink, green, and blue rainbow sheen — full moon on the belly, cranes on the bust, pine on the hips, clouds and waves on the legs. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, both hands clasped loosely behind her lower back, shoulders drawn back, chest and belly facing the camera. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch caged black lacquer platform stiletto sandals with mother-of-pearl accents at each junction.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, black with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm key with strong raking side light so the mother-of-pearl flashes rainbow. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
